name: portfolio-design-toolkit
description: Portfolio and frontend design workflows that preserve project identity, coordinate specialist design skills, and guide redesign, UI motion, reference analysis, audit, polish, and pre-release verification.

interface.shortDescription: Direct, redesign, audit and polish portfolio web experiences
interface.longDescription: A project-first portfolio design toolkit that preserves PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and AGENTS.md as source-of-truth, then routes work to focused skills for redesign, authored visual direction, React Bits integration, reference-site analysis and final UI/UX polish.
defaultPrompt: Improve this portfolio without replacing its established visual identity. Choose only the specialist skills that materially help.
Audit this portfolio page, identify the highest-impact UX, motion and visual problems, then propose a bounded fix plan.
Use a reference site for interaction and layout evidence, but reinterpret it through this project's own design system.
Polish this portfolio for release, focusing on responsive behavior, interaction regressions, accessibility and performance.
